title: Wandering will not quench this fire
summary: Doubt is quenched inwardly, not by more wandering. Bring the mind back to what is clear enough to keep.
takeaway: Bring the mind back to what is clear enough to keep.
lifeApplication: Before researching one more answer, repeat the clearest line you already trust until the breathing slows.

source.shortMeaning: Doubt is quenched inwardly, not by more wandering.
source.lifeApplication: Sit still with one clear line before you go searching again.
